subject: Scorecraft: draft narrative + evidence index for EOQ QBR
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Scorecraft: draft narrative + evidence index for EOQ QBR

Team — attached is the first pass of the EOQ scoring narrative and the evidence index (scorecraft_v1.xlsx + evidence-index.md). I tried to keep the writeup short so the slide deck can pull the 2–3 line judgment per objective. Key asks: please do a quick pass today/tomorrow on the O2 and O4 rationales, and flag any evidence gaps we should surface in the QBR slides.

Highlights:
- O1 (Serving runtime): green — achieved throughput uplift; see telemetry snapshot refs in evidence-index.
- O2 (Cost per token): amber — met unit cost target but quality regressions noted on long-tail prompts.
- O3 (Dedicated adoption): green — committed customers exceeded target by 12%.
- O4 (Observability): red/amber — adoption is there but instrumentation gaps create evidence variance.

Open questions for leadership calibration:
1) Do we keep O2 as amber with a note on prompt regressions or mark it green because unit cost hit the target?
2) For O4, do we call out the two missing telemetry captures as a single evidence caveat or list individually?

Attachments:
- scorecraft_v1.xlsx (scoring matrix + line items)
- evidence-index.md (links to dashboards + short excerpts)

Next steps:
- Laura: O2 callout and suggested wording for the narrative
- Vivek: anything that needs to escalate to Exec summary?
- Marissa: capture comms bullet for customer-facing QBR notes

Thanks — I’ll incorporate feedback and circulate a consolidated file for sign-off by Wednesday.

—
Jasmine Liu
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Scorecraft: draft narrative + evidence index for EOQ QBR

Thanks Jasmine — good concise framing. Two quick edits inline and a short comment doc attached.

Inline notes:
- O2: I recommend we keep amber. The unit-cost win is real, but the user-reported regressions (sampled in evidence-index) are enough to justify a mitigation plan mention. Suggest the narrative: "Unit-cost target achieved; however, signal shows a measurable quality regression on >512-token tail prompts — mitigation plan in place."
- O4: list the two missing captures separately. Call them out in the appendix so the main narrative stays crisp.

I attached O2-rationale-comments.pdf with a suggested 2-line wording you can drop in. If you want I can paste the exact sentence here.

Also consider adding a single-slide appendix mapping evidence file -> dashboard tab for quick reference during Q/A.

Laura
VP, Customer Success
